commit_message: Complete ADR 0121 typed document authoring parity
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0121 typed document parity
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the remaining first-release ADR 0121 typed-document parity slice on current main. Adds a shared transactional typed-document service for Material, Project Settings, and Animation Set; registers the capabilities through ADR 0132; exposes equivalent CLI and live Editor-attached MCP paths; routes Material and Project Settings GUI commits through the shared service; and routes Animation Set granular GUI edits plus undo/redo through the same live revision boundary. Persisted schemas, Stable IDs, and existing Scene/Prefab/Graph/UI architecture remain unchanged.

## Architecture

MCP remains Editor-attached and does not become a competing file writer. CLI persistence continues through ProjectRoot confinement and existing canonical document writers. Existing ADR 0132 registry-driven discovery and generic invocation are extended rather than duplicated.

## Validation

Run the repository Windows Validation workflow for the affected scope and follow all required CI checks.
